title: The Hollow of the Weeping Wood Revisited
author: Jonah Oyelaran
blurb: Casper Vasquez, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
